title: Judgment on Israel

questions.question: For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not revoke the punishment, because he burned to lime the bones of the king of where?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:1 (ESV): "because he burned to lime the bones of the king of Edom."

questions.question: Judah is punished because they have rejected the law of the Lord and have not kept his what?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:4 (ESV): "because they have rejected the law of the Lord, and have not kept his statutes,"

questions.question: Israel is punished because they sell the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of what?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:6 (ESV): "because they sell the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals--"

questions.question: They lay themselves down beside every altar on garments taken in what?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:8 (ESV): "they lay themselves down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge,"

questions.question: I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:9 (ESV): "Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars,"

questions.question: Moab shall die amid uproar, amid shouting and the sound of the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:2 (ESV): "Moab shall die amid uproar, amid shouting and the sound of the trumpet;"

questions.question: Their lies have led them astray, those after which their what walked?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:4 (ESV): "but their lies have led them astray, those after which their fathers walked."

questions.question: A man and his father go in to the same girl, so that my holy name is what?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:7 (ESV): "a man and his father go in to the same girl, so that my holy name is profaned;"

questions.question: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for what?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:11 (ESV): "And I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites."

questions.question: But you made the Nazirites drink wine, and commanded the prophets, saying, "You shall not..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:12 (ESV): "and commanded the prophets, saying, 'You shall not prophesy.'"

questions.question: Behold, I will press you down in your place, as a cart full of what presses down?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:13 (ESV): "Behold, I will press you down in your place, as a cart full of sheaves presses down."

questions.question: Flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not retain his strength, nor shall the mighty save his what?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:14 (ESV): "Flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not retain his strength, nor shall the mighty save his life;"

questions.question: He who handles the bow shall not stand, and he who is swift of foot shall not save himself, nor shall he who rides the what save his life?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:15 (ESV): "nor shall he who rides the horse save his life;"

questions.question: And he who is stout of heart among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, declares the Lord.
questions.explanation: Amos 2:16 (ESV): "And he who is stout of heart among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day,"

questions.question: I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness to possess the land of whom?
questions.explanation: Amos 2:10 (ESV): "and led you forty years in the wilderness to possess the land of the Amorite."

key_verse_text: Thus says the Lord: "For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not revoke the punishment, because they have rejected the law of the Lord, and have not kept his statutes, but their lies have led them astray, those after which their fathers walked."
